# Awesome Blender

> Curated bilingual (EN/ZH) directory of 600 Blender add-ons, AI & MCP tools, 3D assets, HDRIs, standalone utilities, tutorials, and community resources — 567 free entries, 202 GitHub repositories, and 40 official Blender Extensions.

Use the section Markdown indexes or JSON catalog below to retrieve verified URLs, licenses, and descriptions without hallucinating links. The web directory at `https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/` supports query filters: `?section=`, `?category=`, `?subgroup=`, `?q=`, `?price=free|paid`, `?platform=extensions|github|open-source|superhive|gumroad`, and `?license=gpl|mit|zero|cc`.

## Machine-Readable Catalog

- [Full Catalog (Markdown)](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-Markdown dump of all 6 sections, 46 categories, and 600 entries.
- [Structured Catalog (JSON)](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/catalog.json): Lossless bilingual EN/ZH catalog JSON (aggregate `stats` plus structured `sections -> categories -> entries`).
- [Interactive Web Directory](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/): Searchable directory of downloadable add-ons, AI/MCP tools, 3D assets, and standalone apps.

## Sections

- [Add-ons](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms/add-ons.md): 161 entries across 10 categories (Simulation/Physics, Generator/Builder, Modeling, Animation, Render Engine (+5 more)).
- [AI & MCP](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms/ai-mcp.md): 38 entries across 3 categories (MCP, Agents & Skills, Generative 3D & ComfyUI, Synthetic Data & Benchmarks).
- [Resources](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms/resources.md): 129 entries across 8 categories (3D Models, Mocap/Animation, Textures, Blender Scenes/Files, HDRIs (+3 more)).
- [Standalone](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms/standalone.md): 86 entries across 8 categories (3D Tools, Various Tools, Photogrammetry, Texture/Material, Terrain & Height Maps (+3 more)).
- [Tutorials](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms/tutorials.md): 80 entries across 11 categories (Beginning, Modeling, Geometry Nodes, Shader Nodes, Animation (+6 more)).
- [Social](https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms/social.md): 106 entries across 6 categories (Explore Artworks, Communities, Accounts, YouTube Channels, Blogs (+1 more)).
